NIGOQ.notes: Input 3, External Final Input, replaces the final oscillator's generated wave rather than being mixed with it (src/NIGOQ.cpp:1109-1112); the modulation EXT IN does the same for the modulation oscillator (src/NIGOQ.cpp:1025-1030).
